findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: link, hooks, command, explain_command, sandbox_run, alert, send_feedback · Private data: setup, connect, link, revoke_token, unlink, catalog, entry, events, hooks, command, explain_command, sandbox_run, sandbox_results, pricing, live_limits, alert, send_feedback · Public sink: setup, connect, link, entry, events, hooks, command, explain_command, sandbox_run, sandbox_results, alert, send_feedback · Destructive: setup, link, unlink, entry, command, explain_command, sandbox_run, alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: link, hooks, command, explain_command, sandbox_run, alert, send_feedback · Private data: setup, connect, link, revoke_token, unlink, catalog, entry, events, hooks, command, explain_command, sandbox_run, sandbox_results, pricing, live_limits, alert, send_feedback · Public sink: setup, connect, link, entry, events, hooks, command, explain_command, sandbox_run, sandbox_results, alert, send_feedback · Destructive: setup, link, unlink, entry, command, explain_command, sandbox_run, alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
